reviewer: independent reviewer B, Gate B wave C
verdictRationale: Unchanged by source verification, which passed: the bytes match the committed pin, the visible 'AOC-CR-296, Rev. 3/25' agrees with REV-2025-03, and the source is a clean blank form. The open question is not about the bytes. AOC-CR-296 is captioned 'DISTRICT ATTORNEY PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION', its identity block is 'Name And Address Of Defendant', its signature block is 'District Attorney Name (type or print)', it states on its own face that it is filed by the district attorney and requires no filing fee, and page 2 closes with a NOTE TO DISTRICT ATTORNEY. The source record nevertheless classifies it participant_completed and participantFillable true, and the artifact is a prosecutor's instrument pre-filled with the participant's identity. Whether LegalEase should hand a participant a district attorney's petition is an owner's decision, and it governs whether the two technical corrections below are worth making. Both remain required if the family is kept.

historicalObjections.originalObjection: protection established by geometry where required, not label alone
historicalObjections.reviewerFinding: Not closed for this family, and this is where the unsound geometry does visible damage. StreetAddr and MailAddr — the defendant's own address lines, sitting at x=38 directly between the bound name line at y=652..665 and the bound city line at y=626 — are refused as protected_page_region, category prosecutor, under regionHeading 'DISTRICT ATTORNEY PETITION'. That heading is a line of the form's title block in the right-hand column, not the section that governs those widgets. The result is a filed petition carrying a name and a city and no street address.

No duplicated or misplaced address value appears — but that is partly because the street address is not written at all. Separately DLState takes participant.state, which the guards do not catch because the field carries no printed caption and the binder had only the field name to work from. See WCB-B-296-DLSTATE.
Emission satisfied; contract verifier still regenerates rather than reads. Still open, as the record says.

findings.fieldOrRectangle: StreetAddr, rect x=38 y=652 w=278 h=13; and MailAddr, rect x=38 y=639 w=278 h=13
findings.observedResult: Both are refused with reason protected_page_region, category prosecutor, regionHeading 'DISTRICT ATTORNEY PETITION'. The finalized artifact shows 'Jordan Avery Reyes' on the first line of the defendant name-and-address box, an empty second line, and 'Springfield' on the fourth. The filing carries a name and a city and no street address.
findings.requiredResult: StreetAddr carries participant.street_address inside its own rectangle, as it does on AOC-CR-287, AOC-CR-288 and AOC-CR-298 where the same address block is bound without incident.
findings.smallestCorrection: Fix region attribution per WCB-B-REGION-ATTRIBUTION so the title-block line in the right-hand column is not treated as the governing heading for a widget in the left-hand column, then re-derive and re-render this family.
findings.provenHow: read off the rendered contact sheet and confirmed against the map's own bindingRefusals entry and the census rectangles

findings.fieldOrRectangle: DLState, rect x=177 y=602 w=45 h=16
findings.observedResult: DLState is bound to participant.state on factBasis field_name. The census records labelBasis 'no_printed_caption_within_reach', so the binder matched the token 'State' inside the field name alone. DLState is the second cell of the 'Drivers License No. | State | Race | Sex' row and sits immediately right of DLNo at x=37 w=138 on the same line; it is the state that issued the driver's licence, not the participant's state of residence. The canonical fixture hides the error because participant.state is 'XX' and both readings render identically.
findings.requiredResult: Either the field is refused, as the equivalent field is on the other three families in this shard — PetitionerState and DLState are refused on AOC-CR-287, AOC-CR-288 and AOC-CR-298 — or it is bound to a driver's-licence-state fact the platform actually holds.
findings.smallestCorrection: Add the driver's-licence cluster to the government_identifier rule's name test so DLState is refused on its name the way DLNo already is, then re-derive and re-render.
findings.inconsistencyNoted: the same conceptual field is refused on three families in this shard and bound on the fourth, which is itself evidence that the decision is not being made on a stable input

advisories.severity: documented behaviour, recorded for the owner
advisories.observation: When a value cannot fit its rectangle at the minimum font size the renderer refuses it rather than clipping, and records the refusal as unfittable_refused_not_clipped. On AOC-CR-287 the boundary fixture drops FileNumber1 entirely: requiredWidthAtMin 118 against a 73pt rectangle. The canonical fixture fits at 68.9pt in the same 73pt cell, so the margin is thin.
advisories.whyItIsNotABlockerHere: the stated approval criteria forbid clipping, truncation and unreadable fitting. Refusing to draw is none of those, it is fail-safe, and the family's own overflow report names every instance.
advisories.whyItStillMatters: a participant with a long case number gets a blank charge-table cell and no notice that anything was withheld.
advisories.smallestCorrection: surface refused-for-width values to the participant, or allow the cell to wrap.
